gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o3 -> i8: Iterator remove() cannot be called at this time
UPDATED o5 -> i10: No more elements in the iteration
ADDED i2: When the iterator is backed by a mutable ListIterator, remove() after a successful next() should delegate to that ListIterator and succeed.
ADDED i3: Build a list holding a single element (a Boolean produced by a transformer).
ADDED i4: Drive an ObjectGraphIterator over the list's ListIterator.
ADDED i5: findNextByIterator may be invoked with an arbitrary (foreign) iterator; here a root-object iterator with a null transformer descends into another iterator.
ADDED i6: Calling remove() before any element has been returned by next() must throw IllegalStateException, because no underlying iterator has been used yet.
ADDED i9: next() on an iterator backed by an empty collection must throw NoSuchElementException.
ADDED i11: findNextByIterator with two independent iterators built from the same root/transformer still leaves the two iterators as distinct objects.
ADDED i12: A constant transformer always yields the same value, so iterating a nested ObjectGraphIterator returns that value (419).
ADDED i13: findNextByIterator can be handed an iterator whose root is null; the iterators involved remain distinct objects.
ADDED i14: findNext given an iterator value descends into it (findNextByIterator path) rather than treating it as a plain element.
ADDED i15: An ObjectGraphIterator can itself be used as the root object of another ObjectGraphIterator; constructing the nested pair must succeed.
